Name: (CP) Cat Trees and Dog Houses (Yellog's Wood Buildings)
Author: morphinpink
Description:
As requested by some users, this is a simple recolor of the new cat trees and dog houses introduced in the 1.6 update to match [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings[/url].


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZcLAPDj.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure your game, SMAPI and Content Patcher are installed and up to date.
[*]Download this mod. Unzip in the Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XaxBwuY.png[/img]﻿
